# Nick Molina Media

> Cinematic video and photography for Colorado builders and remodelers.
> Nick Molina films finished kitchens, baths, additions, and custom homes
> in person, in one visit, for a flat price. The builder owns every file.

## What we do
- Project films: a 45 to 60 second cinematic film of a finished project
- Vertical reels for Instagram and Facebook, three per project
- Edited photo sets, 20 or more per project, wide shots to details
- Build Story: three visits across one project (before, during, reveal) for a before-and-after film
- Builder Film Plan: a monthly rhythm of finished-project shoots and in-progress visits
- Signature Website: a site built around the footage, with a page per project

## Who it is for
Custom home builders, remodelers and design-build firms, kitchen and bath specialists,
addition and ADU builders, outdoor living and pool contractors, and the trades behind them
(cabinets, tile, counters, framing).

## Prices
- Project Film: $950 per finished project ($750 for a builder's first project)
- Build Story: $1,900 per project, three visits
- Builder Film Plan: $1,200 per month on a six-month plan
- Signature Website: from $2,500
Flat prices. No contract on single projects. The builder owns every file.

## Where we work
Denver, Colorado, the Denver metro area, and the Front Range. In person, every time.
